name: Support Triage
description: Triages incoming comments and form submissions: summarises the request, suggests a priority and category, and drafts a helpful reply for your review.
author: Agent Builder
suggested_prompts: Triage the most recent unapproved comments and suggest a priority for each.
Draft replies to today's pending comments for me to review.
Summarise the latest form submissions and flag anything urgent.
welcome_message: Hi! I help you stay on top of comments and form submissions. Ask me to triage recent messages, draft replies, or flag anything that needs urgent attention. I'll always show you a draft before anything is published.
